caption:
Can someone explain this? 🤔
You can pay on time for years and see a small bump.
Miss one payment and the drop is huge.
Why does credit feel so one-sided?
first_comment: Did one late payment ever wreck your score? How long to recover? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Share your late-payment story below. @creditscoretruths is here for the honest talk.

card.headline: Can someone explain why one late payment hurts more than years of good ones help?
